name: Universal Set
instructions: none found; the model file builds the set's racer (its submodels are named after booklet 120270), and every line below is inferred from the model file itself

functions.does: The knob on the rear deck steers the front wheels: its upright shaft has a crown gear at the foot that turns a 24-tooth gear on a long shaft running forward under the cockpit, and an 8-tooth gear at the shaft's front end slides the steering rack, which swings both steering arms.
functions.source: inferred: from the gears in the model file (knob p250 on the upright axle p151, crown gear p167, 24-tooth gear p108 and 8-tooth gear p121 on the 10 axle p107, steering rack p98 in its holder); unsure whether the knob is meant as the racer's steering control or the 8-tooth gear under it does something else

functions.does: Rolling the racer works its engine: the right rear half-axle carries a crankshaft, and the connecting rod on it pumps the piston up and down in the cylinder on the rear deck.
functions.source: inferred: from the crankshaft p17 on the right rear axle p16, connecting rod p18, piston p28 and cylinder p114 in the model file
functions.note: only the right rear wheel drives it; the left rear wheel turns on its own half-axle

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely, the rear two each on its own half-axle.
